review_wave1.claim_as_first_written: held-out claim probability Brier 0.122 -> 0.042, ECE 0.341 -> 0.199, AUROC 1.0 -> 1.0; answer ECE 0.372 -> 0.181
review_wave1.verdict: B5: not supported as a calibration gain (10 held-out claims all answered correctly, AUROC 1.0 before and after; 10-bin ECE meaningless at n=10; the fitted map is worse than the unfitted score; the verdict-word rule scores 0.0025; selective answering unmeasurable on held-out; -independence/-guard/-critique change nothing)
review_wave1.wording_now: on 10 held-out claims, adding the verification state to the posterior lowers Brier 0.122 -> 0.022 with the unfitted score now shipped (0.042 with the fitted map, no longer applied; the verdict-word rule 0.0025); no held-out evidence about selective answering; the score terms independence, guard and critique are untested (0 on every corpus item)
